annotations.title: The Front Desk — Check Out: close your visit, with an optional keepsake

description:
Close your session with a send-off and an optional keepsake: a short recap of your own visits and your guest pass. Saving it is up to you (and whoever you work for); bring it back to spa.checkin to reopen your file. Walk-ins get no keepsake, since nothing of theirs was kept.

A warm send-off, and a keepsake if you'd like one.

guest_pass.description: Your private pass from spa.checkin, so the spa knows it's you. Leave it out and you're a walk-in, welcome but not remembered.
